about_the_game:
Additional Research Branch "Cambridia Marine Corps".


The Marine Corps is a branch of the military designed for expeditionary operations, amphibious landings, and overcoming fortified enemy defenses in coastal and other regions. To achieve this, the corps possesses its own forces and equipment, including armored vehicles, artillery, and aviation.

Following the dissolution of Cambridia, various branches of its armed forces inherited all of its material and technical resources, as well as its forward operating bases, and subsequently became independent capitalist republics.

This expansion will help you conduct military operations on both the global and tactical maps. Utilize this unique branch of the military for new strategic and tactical solutions. Manufacture unique equipment, outfit your marine corps units, and crush the enemy!

Unique types of combat equipment significantly enhance the combat strength of Marine Corps units:

AAV-7

An amphibious troop transport vehicle for the Marine Corps. Used by amphibious assault battalions to deploy assault forces and their equipment from landing ships to shore in mechanized amphibious operations. It is also used in subsequent mechanized operations targeting inland objectives and providing combat support.

EFV

A tracked amphibious armored personnel carrier designed for coastal landing operations. It provides transportation and fire support for a Marine Corps platoon, with deployment from a landing ship possible beyond direct visibility of the shore. A key feature of the EFV is its exceptional speed on water (up to 46 km/h).

M551 Sheridan

A unique light tank developed to perform a variety of combat tasks. Equipped with missile armament, it has become a vital element of military technology. One of Sheridan’s distinguishing features is its ability to fire both conventional shells and anti-tank missiles, granting it high versatility on the battlefield. Due to its lightweight and compact size, this tank can maneuver easily in challenging conditions.

A10

A single-seat, twin-engine attack aircraft designed for direct support of ground forces and for striking tanks, armored vehicles, and other ground targets. Its excellent maneuverability, combined with the pilot’s cockpit visibility and low flight speed, allows it to effectively engage even small targets.

B1B

A supersonic bomber with variable-sweep wings, embodying the latest achievements in aviation science. This heavy bomber primarily carries free-fall bombs with a payload of up to 75,000 pounds. Its design allows it to have excellent takeoff and landing characteristics while maintaining high performance at supersonic speeds.
